versions.changelog:
Initial release of the openclaw-config-expert skill.

- Provides expert-level OpenClaw configuration management and best practices.
- Supports configuration validation, intelligent repair, agent management, routing optimization, plugin management, and version migration.
- Includes Hermes-powered emergency recovery for rapid rollback and system restore.
- Offers command-line tools for fine-grained configuration editing, optimization, and validation.
- Contains comprehensive templates and documentation for production, cost-saving, and local-first setups.
- Integrates intent-based routing to automatically delegate tasks related to configuration, versions, plugins, and emergency recovery.
